name: Launch Vehicle Design
summary: Conceptual and preliminary design of launch vehicles: architecture, staging, propulsion selection, structures, mass and cost.

topics.name: Launch vehicle architectures: stages, boosters, upper stages
Staging optimisation with real mass fractions
Propulsion system selection and engine count
Mass estimating relationships and mass budgets
Propellant tanks: common bulkheads, pressure stabilisation, materials
Interstages, thrust structures and separation systems
Avionics, electrical and flight termination systems
Small-launcher, heavy-lift and super-heavy-lift design trades
Case studies: Saturn V, Falcon 9, Ariane, Electron, Starship
